rationale: The implementation uses multi-start gradient ascent with central differences and bounded backtracking. It leverages shared candidates from prior experiments as initial starting points to improve convergence, while also generating random starts to maintain exploration. The algorithm respects the budget constraint by tracking evaluation calls and stopping when the budget is exhausted. The gradient is computed using central differences, and the line search uses a backtracking strategy to ensure progress. The best point found is returned along with all observations.
